title: Wii U: sign-in and friends are built, console tests are next
body: The Wii U network is built on the server side. Sign-in, identity, friends, friend requests and friend notifications already run on OpenPak, using the same account you use on the website. Several Wii U titles are in beta testing and fifteen more can be requested from the catalogue. The console side of sign-in is still being proven on real hardware, so we are not yet claiming a finished console connection. Cloud saves and SpotPass-style downloads are not available yet.
footer: OpenPak Networks — built in the open.
